Allow Omni Node to install updates
Android asks once before an app may install its own updates. On the next screen, turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back.
Updates aren\'t allowed yet. Turn on \"Allow from this source\" for Omni Node, then tap Get it again.

This Omni Node was built with an older signing key, so Android can\'t update it in place. Uninstall Omni Node, then install the new version from the release page. Uninstalling resets this phone\'s node key, peers and pairings. After that, updates install over the top.
